reason: The requirements settle the field's nature, length, optionality, translation, product-level scope and end-to-end delivery. They only cover display on the product page, so cart, checkout and emails are never excluded. They name a migration but do not rule out a backfill, list GraphQL exposure but say nothing about webhook payloads, CSV export or filtering and search, and never state the MANAGE_PRODUCTS permission. No contradictions were planted, and I found no conflicting pair of statements.
